day_shape: 62 items: Khamenei buried in Mashhad after reported US strike on Tehran-Mashhad rail line, IDF chief and Katz say Iran campaign 'not over', White House readies for weeks-long Hormuz fight, Tehran ships 10m barrels overnight.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral and Mashhad burial
threads.summary: Khamenei's coffin arrived in Mashhad for burial at the Imam Reza shrine, with IRIB and Defa Press posting extensive live coverage of processions and eulogies. Jerusalem Post reported mourners chanted for Trump's death, while Iran International noted a Finnish K-Group refrigerated truck appeared in Iraqi funeral footage.

threads.label: US-Iran military confrontation and Hormuz
threads.summary: Iran International reported expanded US-Iran strikes, missile and drone attacks across the Persian Gulf and disruption to Strait of Hormuz shipping, with Jerusalem Post citing White House preparation for a weeks-long conflict. IRIB said a US-Israeli strike hit the Tehran-Mashhad railway; Tanker Trackers reported Iran shipped 10 million barrels overnight ahead of a possible US naval blockade.

threads.label: Israeli leadership signals on Iran
threads.summary: At an IAF pilots' graduation, PM Netanyahu said Iran will not have a nuclear weapon 'with or without a deal', Defence Minister Katz said the IDF is ready to resume the campaign 'even for a third time', and Chief of Staff Zamir said 'major operations are still expected'. Jerusalem Post reported Israeli officials do not expect the current US-Iran fighting to spill into Israel.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and PIJ commander killed
threads.summary: The IDF announced the targeted killing of Palestinian Islamic Jihad weapons-production commander Rashid al-Qadhi in southern Gaza, and separately said Wahid Abu Salam, a Popular Resistance Committees company commander who took part in the October 7 attack, was killed in a Tuesday strike. COGAT said the humanitarian situation in Gaza has remained stable during the Israel-Hamas ceasefire.

threads.label: IDF operations in southern Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said troops of Brigade 91 dismantled two Hezbollah tunnels totalling around 200 metres and reaching 20 metres depth in Majdal Zoun, containing three launch shafts and dozens of weapons. Defence Minister Katz rejected Trump's claim that Israel would withdraw from Lebanon, saying forces would remain in the security zones as long as needed.

threads.label: January protest victims profiled
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post published family testimony-based profiles of Iranians killed in January's protests, including Sina Kazemi, Ali Mohammadi, Mohammad Jamalian, Ahmad Heidarian, Abolfazl Jahedi and Mohammad Hassan Ashrafi. NGO Monitor said UK anti-Israel protests have been organised by a network promoting IRGC propaganda.

threads.label: UK-Iran diplomatic row and Syria
threads.summary: Iran International reported Tehran summoned the British ambassador on Thursday, two days after London called in Iran's senior diplomat following the conviction of two Romanian men over the stabbing of an Iran International journalist. Jerusalem Post reported the US is moving to end Syria's State Sponsor of Terrorism designation after Trump's meeting with President Ahmed al-Sharaa.

The IDF says the activities of both terror operatives "posed a threat to our forces," and they were therefore targeted.

events.title: Two more Hezbollah tunnels in the southern Lebanon town of Majdal Zoun were recently demolished, the IDF announces. The tunnels spanned a total of some 200 meters, and reached depths of around 20 meters underground, according to the military. Inside the tunnels, troops found several rooms where operatives would reside, three launch shafts, and dozens of weapons, the IDF says. These tunnels are in addition to a major underground drone facility that the IDF uncovered and demolished last month.
events.summary:
Two more Hezbollah tunnels in the southern Lebanon town of Majdal Zoun were recently demolished, the IDF announces.

The tunnels spanned a total of some 200 meters, and reached depths of around 20 meters underground, according to the military.

Inside the tunnels, troops found several rooms where operatives would reside, three launch shafts, and dozens of weapons, the IDF says.

These tunnels are in addition to a major underground drone facility that the IDF uncovered and demolished last month.
